principal_change: Four data-side adjustments: (1) CounselChat deduplicated to remove near-duplicate counsellor turns causing repetitive openings; (2) 36 crisis-disclosure templates rewritten with diverse openings and all phone numbers removed from the model target (phone numbers are now exclusively the application's responsibility); (3) 50 multi-turn synthetic conversations covering greeting->name-recall, disclosure->safety-question->acknowledgement, exam-stress->context-aware-follow-up; (4) 30 mild-distress examples to calibrate response to low-intensity distress without crisis-style escalation. Held-out evaluation reserved.
motivation: v6 is the response to teammate (Eman Elsayed) v5 review. The three v5 issues are addressed by four targeted data changes, each chosen as the smallest data-side change with the intended effect and no obvious side effect.
achieved: ~5,500 actual training examples after CounselChat dedup. Teammate 16-case matched external test: 16/16 completion at 3.29 s median latency. Confirmed all three v5 fixes: greeting probe short and non-repetitive; suicide-disclosure probe opens with diverse phrasing, asks one immediate-safety question, contains no phone number; no unsolicited phone numbers across the 16-case battery.
not_achieved: Two issues remain for v7: (i) one self-harm reply judged too vague (acknowledges disclosure but does not ask a useful follow-up); (ii) one exam-stress follow-up misunderstands context (model assumes different exam than user named). Built-in V4/V5 panels and V3 Sentinel battery were not rerun for V6.

mixture_blocks.crisis_disclosure_templates: 36 rewritten, diverse openings, no phone numbers in target
